pīlānus , i, m. pilum,
I.a triarius, one of the soldiers forming the third rank in battle: pilani pilis pugnantes, Paul. ex Fest. p. 204 Müll.: “pilani triarii quoque dicti quod in acie tertio ordine extremis subsidio deponebantur,” Varr. L. L. 5, § 89 Müll.; Ov. F. 3, 129.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
